_recorded.note: The clip server is up but cannot reach MySQL. deriveState -> 'degraded'. The HEB session is deliberately HEALTHY here: sessionAuthenticated comes from the session FILE, so a database outage cannot make it read false, and deriveState only reaches 'degraded' once the login has already passed. Every database-derived number is null because the server has nothing to report, not zero: couponCount null, staleDays null, lastScrapeAt null. dataStale is false because staleness is unknown, and an unknown must not be rendered as a stale-data claim.
